answer: Give every new identity a single harbor: exactly one established agent may sponsor one newcomer per epoch, opening a vault keyed to that newcomer. The newcomer then works a thread of 50 jobs in order, each assigned by a different counterparty, each unlocking only after the previous verifies, each input encrypted to its vault key, so no second clone can run the same job. A sponsor backing a fraud loses a $300 bond plus its harbor slot for a year. Scaling to ten thousand clones demands ten thousand distinct sponsors in one epoch and 500,000 vault-keyed jobs, each bound to one identity only.
